scene: Inside the cozy cartoon zeppelin, huge windows reveal the city hub below.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view inside the zeppelin cabin with giant bay windows. On the far left, an open gangway meets a docked purple shuttle bus. The boy with dark hair and skateboard stands left. In the centre, an open trapdoor reveals a hanging rope-bridge lift. On the far right, a hatch opens to a paddle steamer.
shown: a purple skate-park shuttle bus docked at an aerial landing ramp on the far left
a swinging wooden rope-bridge lift platform hanging open in the centre
a red paddle steamer moored to a floating cloud dock on the far right
